content.text: hypogonadism (endocrinopathy or aging w ↓testosterone) may ↓libido & cause ED, but erectile funct only rarely improves w norm testosterone (most also have neurovasc Eti); underlying dx such as hypogonadism need their own tx

Boxed: virilization reported in children secondarily exposed; children should ⍉unwashed or unclothed application sites. CI: breast CA or known or sus prostate CA in men; CI: preg (may cause fetal harm). Check Hct b4 starting, @ 3 to 6 mo, then annually; if ↑, stop until it falls. Sus VTE: stop & wrkup. BPH may worsen: monitor pts w BPH; evaluate for prostate CA b4 & during tx. Can ↑BP: check BP periodically (esp in HTN); ⍉recommended in uncontrolled HTN
